what: Stage 10 perplexity, 8191 tokens of Alice in Wonderland (tests/golden/eval_text.txt), teacher-forced in 512-token windows, exp(mean nll); tools/ppl
quantisation: group 128 along the input dim, bf16 scales; int8 symmetric round-to-nearest; int4 asymmetric with zero point, round-to-nearest, no calibration
reading: int8 is lossless to three digits; int4 round-to-nearest at group 128 costs +32-35% perplexity, the known gap that GPTQ/AWQ-style calibration or smaller groups close (out of scope).
